notes.text: Read 2026-11-20. The sheet bears author page 18 at the head and a lighter footer 37. It continues a description of generalized graph morphisms: an application on the vertex/arc disjoint union, then the data of a vertex map and a stable selected arc part with compatibility conditions. The slanted note adds that the origin and endpoint of each remaining arrowed arc have the same image under f_S. The final paragraph describes a corresponding subgraph with the same vertices, then begins a sentence about composition which continues beyond this page. This is a reading summary, not an independently verified mathematical argument. The cancelled target superscripts and three live readings remain uncertain; these are editorial reading uncertainties, not an attributed authorial doubt statement.

All 47 corrected C–H packet rows were read. H’s note reporting author page 18 is editorial presentation of a number actually present, not an omission. H’s editorial note about B in the next item is excluded from the source transcription. Its marginal (45) and display (45) duplicate one visible brace label. The complete margin is carried at the brace; the two occurrence-specific arrows over a and the readable barred-m image phrase are preserved. The prime notation in item 2 is grouped within one superscript brace only to avoid a double-superscript TeX construction; this does not change the reading. No OCR, external lookup, or TeX compilation was used.
